rules.desc: High topographic position combined with south-facing moisture deficit doubles spring desiccation hazard.
Springs near ridgelines with limited upslope collection area desiccate rapidly during droughts.
Unpaved rural road cuts directly rupture shallow aquifer fracture lines and induce siltation.

rules.desc: Intact native canopy and natural concave depressions maintain near-perfect hydrological resilience.
